1 غَرَسَهُ , aor.
غَرِسَ , (S, A, Msb, K,) inf. n. غَرْسٌ, (S, Msb,) He planted it, or fixed it in the ground; (A, K;) namely, a tree; (S, A, Msb, K;) as also ↓ اغرسهُ , (Zj, A, K,) inf. n. إِغْرَاسٌ. (A.) ―
-b2- [Hence,] غَرَسَ فُلَانٌ عِنْدِى نِعْمَةً (tropical:) Such a one established, or settled, in my possession, a benefaction, or boon. (TA.) And غَرَسَ المَعْرُوفَ (tropical:) He did good, or what was beneficent or kind. (IKtt, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
